svg.title: Beyond pass/fail: GitHub Agentic Workflows
svg.desc: Overview of the delivery pipeline with seven GitHub Agentic Workflows around it. Planned CI: select code, build, test Java, APIs and workflows, then check results. Pass permits the next step. Hold stops it. Reports are saved for all outcomes. Current release: check the version tag, check scanners, build and test, ask the readiness agent for a GO or NO-GO issue, wait for production approval by a person, publish packages, create the release and let the notes agent add highlights. Planned reuse: check findings, review inputs, save approved inputs and test again. Agents: security triage, PR security reviewer, daily security report, pipeline failure analyst, release readiness, release notes and security remediation. Each agent starts from a pipeline event, reads with read-only permissions and creates only declared outputs with limits and expiry. People approve fixes and production. Labels describe the design, not live results.
